refinement.semantics: Known memory, known node annotation, exact selected declaration and output-ready are distinct observations. Firsts refer to any selected action of that kind; full original IDs/declarations/source revisions remain in per-think records. model.semantics: Actual output.campModelUsage counters only, not an independent model invocation. Sums count quote observations/calls in recorded outputs, not battles or unique samples.
